[1] A gifted improviser, sketch player and voice-over artist, his impression of Robert De Niro in a sketch entitled "De Niro Sings the Supremes" at The Groundlings, led to him playing a pigeon named Bobby in the cartoon series "Animaniacs", who is based on a character played by De Niro in "Goodfellas".
[2] The band's name is a word derived from Robert De Niro's character in Taxi Driver, Travis Bickle.
[3] Taxi Driver is a 1976 American neo-noir psychological thriller film directed by Martin Scorsese and written by Paul Schrader.
[4] "Nocturnal Animals" is a 2016 American neo-noir psychological thriller film written, co-produced and directed by Tom Ford.
